Rashi on Megillah 16a:12:1.hebrew: ולתעניתו - יום שלישי לתענית היה, שהתחילו להתענות בי"ד בניסן; ומה שאמר המקרא ליום אתמול "שלישי" — "ויהי ביום השלישי ותלבש אסתר מלכות" — יום שלישי לשילוח הרצים היה:
Rashi on Megillah 16a:12:1.english: And to his fasting - It was the third day of the fast, for they had begun to fast on the fourteenth of Nisan; and as for what Scripture says regarding the previous day [calling it] "third" — "Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on her royal apparel" [Esther 5:1] — that was the third day from the dispatching of the couriers.

Rashi on Megillah 16a:14:1.hebrew: אם מזרע היהודים - יש זרע ביהודים, שאם הוא בא מהם, לא תוכל לו:
Rashi on Megillah 16a:14:1.english: If [he is] of the seed of the Jews - There is a [particular] seed among the Jews that if he comes from them, you will not prevail over him:

Rashi on Megillah 16a:16:1.english: This teaches that they brought him in disarray - and he did not wash [himself] properly from his filth.

Rashi on Megillah 16a:19:1.hebrew: מלמד שהיתה מחווה כנגד אחשורוש - מרבוי אתה לומד: "איש צר ואויב המן הרע הזה":
Rashi on Megillah 16a:19:1.english: This teaches that she was pointing toward Ahasuerus - From the extra wording [of the verse], you learn [this]: "An adversary and enemy, this wicked Haman."

Rashi on Megillah 16a:1:1.hebrew: שמשי - סופר המלך, שונא ישראל היה, ומימות כורש היה, כמו שנאמר בספר עזרא (סימן ד), שכתב שטנה על בנין הבית עד שבא כורש וביטלו. ואף בימי אחשורוש עשה כן, שנאמר (שם): "ובמלכות אחשורוש בתחלת מלכותו כתב שטנה":
Rashi on Megillah 16a:1:1.english: Shimshai - The king's scribe — he was a hater of Israel, and he was [active] from the days of Cyrus, as it is stated in the Book of Ezra (Chapter 4) that he wrote an accusation against the building of the Temple until Cyrus came and halted it. And in the days of Ahasuerus as well he did so, as it is stated (ibid.): "And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, he wrote an accusation":

Rashi on Megillah 16a:21:1.hebrew: נופל - לשון עושה והולך: נופל ורוצה לזקוף, והמלאך מפילו:
Rashi on Megillah 16a:21:1.english: [Was] falling [nofel] - [This is] an expression of continuous action: he falls and tries to straighten up, and the angel pushes him down:

Rashi on Megillah 16a:22:1.english: And He hurls upon him - The Holy One, blessed be He, hurls punishment upon the wicked person without compassion:

Rashi on Megillah 16a:22:2.english: From his hand he will surely flee - His supporters and his friends flee from his hand:

Rashi on Megillah 16a:23:1.english: One [assuaging] of Esther - for Ahasuerus was angry over what Haman had done to Esther:

Rashi on Megillah 16a:24:1.english: [The] thing from which that righteous man suffered - Joseph was sold as a slave on account of his brothers' jealousy.

Rashi on Megillah 16a:3:1.english: He had prepared for himself - for his own need:

Rashi on Megillah 16a:6:2.hebrew: הלכות קמיצה - דורש בענינו של יום, וששה עשר בניסן היה, הוא יום תנופת העומר:
Rashi on Megillah 16a:6:2.english: The laws of taking the handful - [Mordecai] was expounding on the topic of the day, and it was the sixteenth of Nisan, [which] is the day of the waving of the Omer.

Rashi on Megillah 16a:8:1.english: And I will trim my hair - And I will remove my hair.

Rashi on Megillah 16a:9:1.english: She bound them - She commanded regarding them to hide them:

Rashi on Megillah 16a:9:3.english: Zuza - A barbers' pair [of shears], similar to scissors:

Tosafot on Megillah 16a:7:1.hebrew: ודחי עשרה אלפי ככרי כספא - שמעתי שעשרה אלפי ככר כסף עולין חצי שקל לכל אחד מישראל, שהיו שש מאות אלף כשיצאו ממצרים, ואמר שיתן לאחשורוש כל פדיונם. ודוק ותשכח:
Tosafot on Megillah 16a:7:1.english: And cast aside ten thousand talents of silver - I have heard that ten thousand talents of silver amount to half a shekel for each one of Israel, who were six hundred thousand when they went out of Egypt, and [Haman] said that he would give Ahasuerus their entire redemption [price]. Examine [this] carefully and you will find [it to be so]:
